transformation_steps_completed.title: Convert All SQL Statements Using DMS MCP Tool

transformation_steps_completed.title: Update Connection Strings to PostgreSQL Format
transformation_steps_completed.notes: Converted both DevConnection and ProdConnection to PostgreSQL format. Replaced Server with Host, added Port and authentication.

transformation_steps_completed.title: Create Final Migration Report and Validate Completeness
transformation_steps_completed.notes: Generated comprehensive migration report with all statistics and validation results.

known_limitations.dms_tool_limitations: DMS MCP tool encountered timeouts for complex CTE queries and validation errors for transaction blocks. All statements required manual conversion.
known_limitations.equivalency_tool_limitations: SQL Equivalency tool returned UNKNOWN for 5 out of 7 statements (complex CTEs with window functions). Tool could only confirm equivalency for simple UPDATE and DELETE statements.
known_limitations.transaction_handling: SQL Server transaction syntax (DECLARE, BEGIN TRANSACTION, SCOPE_IDENTITY) remains in code. These will fail at runtime with PostgreSQL. Requires refactoring to use application-layer transaction management.
known_limitations.runtime_testing: Migration has not been tested against an actual PostgreSQL database. Runtime validation is required.
